name: Ronald Lord, 71, of Montreal (silhouette only)
depiction: Ronald Lord, 71, of Montreal, who pleaded guilty at Croydon Crown Court (August 2025) to smuggling about 8 kg of cocaine in his mobility scooter into Gatwick and was jailed for six years (September 2025). Named because he pleaded guilty and is widely named (NCA, CBC, Global News). Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette, seated or standing in a dock: no face, no features. NOT A LIKENESS. Never shown in a way that implies he does not need his scooter.
